review_report.json.independence_statement: Reviewer independently fetched report 5624 via platform API, recomputed sha256 hash, verified all 9 locators against raw markdown, ran all 11 upstream pytest cases, and probed for extraction defects. Did not consult producer's explanation or internal notes.

Could not independently verify artifact existence (cross-worktree boundary)
Could not re-run the original artifact_indexer tool (lives in m4963's TensorPlatform worktree)
scope_checks_performed: Source hash recomputation (sha256 of markdown UTF-8 bytes)
Section splitting verification (7 sections, line ranges, chars, sha256)
All 9 locator quotes verified as verbatim substrings in markdown/figures
Boundary check (only report 5624 read/written, no verified claims)
Claims policy check (claims=[] allowed for 01 task)
Figure caption matching against platform record figures field
Deterministic rebuild test (re-running generator produces identical manifest)

findings.title: Duplicate locator quote: 5624-ref-01 and 5624-ref-02 share identical quote
findings.description: Both ref-01 and ref-02 have the same locator_quote value. This phrase appears exactly once in the source markdown (line 7). Two distinct ref_ids pointing to the same single occurrence indicates a duplication bug in the path extraction regex logic.

evidence.test_coverage_gap: test_no_duplicate_ids checks ID uniqueness but not quote uniqueness

findings.affected_scope: referenced_artifacts extraction; cosmetic (does not affect hash/section/claims correctness)
findings.recommendation: Deduplicate quotes during extraction or merge into a single ref_id with multiple source locations if intended

findings.title: Lines count: manifest reports 46 but markdown has 47 lines (trailing empty line)
findings.description: The manifest reports size.lines=46. The markdown has 46 newline characters and ends with a newline, producing 47 lines when split (last line empty). Section ranges end at line 46, so 46 is defensible as content lines, but the counting method is not documented.

findings.title: Test suite requires artifacts/ directory which is gitignored
findings.description: The test fixture reads from artifacts/kf/wp-5624-01/kf_result.json, but this path is gitignored. In a fresh clone without the artifacts directory, all 11 tests fail with FileNotFoundError.
findings.recommendation: Add fallback in test fixture to try docs/ path if artifacts/ is missing

findings.title: Internal inconsistency correctly flagged as unresolved
findings.description: The upstream package correctly identified the counting contradiction in the original report and registered it as observation 5624-obs-01 with status=unresolved, without inventing a resolution.

findings.title: All 11 upstream tests pass; schema validation passes
findings.description: After providing the missing artifacts directory, all 11 pytest cases pass. The kf_result.json validates against kf_result.v1.schema.json. Source hash matches contract value. All 9 locators resolve. Boundary constraints satisfied.

checks_not_run: Independent re-execution of artifact_indexer tool (lives in m4963's TensorPlatform worktree, out of scope)
Content digest value recomputation (source artifacts not in this worktree)
Figure image content verification (no png_base64 payload in figures)

overstated_claims.reality: Tests pass only when artifacts/ directory is populated; in a fresh clone without artifacts, all 11 tests error with FileNotFoundError. The upstream report states pytest 11 passed without noting this environmental dependency.

review_report.json.disposition_rationale: The wp-5624-01 output is structurally correct: schema-valid, hash-verified, all locators resolve, boundary constraints met, claims policy followed. The duplicate quote (ref-01/ref-02) is a medium-severity extraction bug but does not affect the core registration correctness. The lines count ambiguity and test environment dependency are low-severity issues. No blocking correctness or security defects found.
remediation: Deduplicate ref-01/ref-02 or merge into single reference
Document line counting convention in manifest
Add docs/ fallback path in test fixture for fresh-clone reproducibility
